blockers.consequence: Pixel equivalence with the origin is `origin-formula`, never golden equivalence. Visual parity stays partial.
blockers.detail: The origin golden (catalog/__golden__/fade.png) needs its harness: a build of the engine and a browser, i.e. executing the origin. Forbidden in this delivery. No golden was invented and none is compared.

blockers.consequence: A future execution of the origin (in its own, authorised environment) may replace `origin-formula` by `origin-output` per case.
blockers.detail: Expectations are transcribed formulas, not the origin's outputs. Mitigation: constants and formula lines are checked against the origin text at generation and by `verify --origin`.

documented_differences.detail: The pilot pipeline is linear throughout and encodes at the end (with dither); the Rust reference and the runtime return the input bytes exactly when intensity x weight x amount is 0. The identity cases pin the exact bytes.
